messages:
maya: quick sync — i'm kicking off spotcheck for newmodel-v2 quant path. baseline is bfloat16/fp32; candidate is int4. want to run curation on prompt-set A (~10k) but reduce dup noise first.
sasha: ok maya — we can run the fuzzy-dedupe pipeline today. i'll spin a sample with similarity threshold 0.82 and surface the top ~2k ambiguous hits for manual review.
devin: quick FYI: int4 baseline showed a 1.8% drop on our summarization slice and some token-repetition issues for ctx > 1024. likely kv-cache precision effects.
ethan: can you paste the eval harness command you'll use? i'll wire in the golden slices and automated regressions.
maya: here's the run i'll use for an initial pass, same as our usual harness: 
``n./eval_harness --model newmodel-v2-int4 --prompts prompts/spotcheckA.jsonl --gold goldsets/spot_gold_v3.jsonl --metrics ppl,exact_match,rouge
```
sasha: for the gold set, i propose a 600-example microgold: 200 longform (>=800 tokens), 200 multi-turn (>=3 turns), 200 ambiguous intents (high annotator disagreement). i'll tag seeds and hand to labelers once dedupe is done.
ops-bot: labeler-queue size: 18 open tasks; avg latency 4h; projected throughput at current concurrency: ~300 examples/day. ETA for 600: ~2 days.
devin: if labeler latency is the blocker we can run an intermediate rerank stage (reranker-v3) to prefilter and only send the top 250 most-uncertain to humans. reduces cost but preserves slice coverage.
maya: decision for this thread: run fuzzy-dedupe -> rerank -> human review of top 250 (by entropy) -> full harness. devin, can you produce rerank config + quick-smoke by EOD?
devin: yes. i'll push config: `rerank.threshold=0.5`, `embed_model=embed-small-v2`, `scoring=entropy+sim` and run a 5k sample smoke.
ethan: once we have human tags, i'll run per-slice regressions (longform / multiturn / ambiguous). if any slice sees >1% relative drop in ROUGE or +3% hallucination rate i'll open an eval-ticket and tag infra for a rollback plan.
sasha: kicking dedupe job now, i'll post logs and sample ids here when ready.
maya: thanks — ping back when rerank config is up or if labeler queue changes. :thumbsup:
